meaning.code bits (per half): bit4 door (room) ahead, bit3 wall ahead, bit2 side opening, bits0-1 = 3-distance
meaning.0-3: open corridor >=4 cells, no side opening within 4 cells; animated with (y&3 facing N/S, x&3 facing E/W)
meaning.8-b: wall ahead, 8=3 cells ahead .. b=directly ahead
meaning.c-f: wall + side opening; LEFT: low bits = wallDist|openDist (OR), RIGHT: low bits = openDist
meaning.10-13: room entrance ahead, 10=3 cells ahead .. 13=directly ahead
meaning.left half: tile map index = code, drawn at byte column $3b3f8 (10, or 0 with map)
meaning.right half: tile map index = code + $14, drawn at byte column $3b3fe (20, or 10 with map)
